metadata.title: SSPP Instance - DNS Secure Email (utoronto.ca)
metadata.remarks: Instance SSPP for the utoronto.ca apex domain, implementing DNS Secure Email for institutional mailbox sending and delegated subdomain sending.

import-profile.remarks: Inherits all normative DNS Secure Email governance, security, monitoring, and assessment requirements.

system-characteristics.system-description: Apex institutional domain for email identity, authorizing mailbox sending via secure-email and delegating campaign and notification sending to approved subdomains.

props.name: domain-role
props.remarks: Apex domain authorizes mailbox sending and delegates other sending to approved subdomains.

props.name: mailbox-sending-pattern
props.remarks: Mailbox sending is provided through secure-email (Exchange Online).

props.name: campaign-sending-delegation
props.remarks: Bulk and campaign sending occurs only from approved subdomains governed by the Email Bulk Messaging Gateway pattern.

props.name: notification-sending-delegation
props.remarks: System and transactional email is sent only from dedicated notification subdomains.

props.name: dmarc-posture
props.remarks: DMARC enforced for the apex domain.

props.name: spf-posture
props.remarks: SPF authorizes only centrally approved mailbox senders; no direct campaign authorization at apex.

props.name: dkim-posture
props.remarks: DKIM required for all authorized senders on the apex domain.

props.name: transport-security
props.remarks: MTA-STS enforced and TLS reporting enabled for the apex domain.

components.title: utoronto.ca Apex Email Domain
components.description: Authoritative DNS domain defining email identity posture and delegating permitted sending to approved services.

links.text: Inherits DNS Secure Email governance and enforcement.

components.remarks: Campaign and notification sending are prohibited at the apex and must occur from approved subdomains.

control-implementation.remarks: DNS Secure Email controls are satisfied through inherited template requirements and central DNS operations. This instance documents scope and delegation only.
